periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axes of the patches are oriented at approximately 45-60 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering medially toward the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The patches exhibit a distinctly oval, teardrop-like morphology with a high vertical-to-horizontal length ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward elongation, with the lowest point of the patch extending significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior edge of the dark band across the scapular region follows a wide, relatively flat U-shape profile.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is substantial, covering roughly 40% of the visible torso height along the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely spaced, positioned on the upper lateral boundaries of the cranium.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears show a smooth, highly convex, semicircular curvature.

other_distinctive_markers: The mandible is depressed, exposing the dentition and tongue; white-colored claws are highly prominent and extended on both forepaws.
